Use case: style-transfer. Edit the supplied reconstruction reference into stylized hand-painted 3D game art at the moderate-detail visual level of Gunfire Reborn. Keep the subject identity, overall dimensions, and four-view FRONT, LEFT, BACK, RIGHT turnaround of ONE identical solid object. Replace photographic erosion, tiny cracks, dense grain and miniature ornament with broad clean faceted planes, bold chunky silhouette, two or three dominant color blocks, soft painted gradients and a few medium-scale edge accents. Matte materials, clear solid volume, no glossy plastic, no photorealistic surface noise. All views must agree on construction and colors; side views show true depth and back is complete. Level strictly orthographic cameras, same scale and baseline, every silhouette fully inside its own panel with white gutters. Pure white featureless background, neutral soft even lighting, minimal shadows. No ground plane, text, labels, landscape, people, detached objects or effects.

Use large coherent masonry blocks and broad beveled edges; avoid many little rubble chips.
